**1.0.** From this release on, versions follow semantic versioning. A change that breaks any of the following needs a new major version:
- the release asset names, image and chart;
- commands and flags;
- JSON fields (including errors, the watch webhook payload and MCP results);
- exit codes and error codes;
- policy keys;
- the config and state layout;
- MCP tool and argument names;
- chart values.

The exact list, and what may still change in minor releases, is in [docs/reference.md § Compatibility](https://github.com/james-tronai/email-cli/blob/v1.0.0/docs/reference.md#compatibility).

The README is now three quickstarts: Hermes on Kubernetes, Hermes on one machine, and Claude Code, Codex and other MCP clients. The detail it used to hold moved to [docs/install.md](https://github.com/james-tronai/email-cli/blob/v1.0.0/docs/install.md), [docs/safety.md](https://github.com/james-tronai/email-cli/blob/v1.0.0/docs/safety.md) and [docs/reference.md](https://github.com/james-tronai/email-cli/blob/v1.0.0/docs/reference.md).

### Pod side

- **Chart `1.0.0`** (`oci://ghcr.io/james-tronai/charts/hermes-email`, or Git `charts/hermes-email` at `v1.0.0`). Image `ghcr.io/james-tronai/email-cli:v1.0.0`.
- **Upgrading from chart 0.9.0 or 0.10.2 needs no values change.** Asset names, policy keys and chart values are unchanged. The skill and the route script ship with the image, so they update together with the changes below.

### Breaking changes since v0.10.2

These were fixed before the compatibility promise starts:
- **Error codes**:
  - a message, draft, thread or attachment that does not exist is now `"code":"not_found"` for every provider. It used to be `provider_error`, with a `provider_code` that differed by provider. `provider_code` is still set.
  - New codes `send_in_progress` (`email send`), and `unreachable` and `unhealthy` (`email watch healthz`). These were `provider_error`.
  - Exit codes are unchanged.
- **Watch webhook payload**: each message has `unread` (true when unread) in place of `is_read`. The route script does not read either.
- **MCP**: `attachments_list` takes `id`, like `get`, `mark` and `move`. It used to take `message_id`.
- **`email doctor`**: check names are snake_case (`idle_push`, `imap_server`, `watch_state`).
- **Unknown subcommands**: `email accounts bogus` exits 2 with a usage error. It used to print help and exit 0.

### Other changes

- `email policy show` includes the `[watch]` section.
- `email hermes config --cron-name` replaces `--cron-job`, matching the other `hermes` commands. `--cron-job` still works.
- The skill names exit code 1. It also tells the agent never to get around a denial by editing the policy file, the account files or `EMAIL_*` variables.
- Docs: `email hermes install --format text` prints the config snippet ready to paste. The test mail should come from another address and stay unread, since watch skips mail that is already read. The policy's limits on one machine are described as they are.
